generalInfo.summary: Profound Software Professional with 8 years of experience in pro-code and low-code development, functional leadership and mentoring with a passion for problem solving and conceptual Work

experiences.title: Senior Specialist Digitalization
experiences.description: Ideator and technical lead of a micro-frontend based platform for the development of internal web-based application for our core chemicals business. Responsible for the overall architecture, technology selection and implementation of key features.
experiences.highlights: Defined the platform architecture and delivered the first production-ready micro-frontend modules used by multiple internal teams.

experiences.title: Team Specialist
experiences.description: Functional Lead for a team of 12 developers and project managers. We built applications for the BASF Global Business Services Unit, especially for internal HR, Finance and Procurement Services on a Java-based RAD environment.
experiences.highlights: Led planning and delivery alignment for a 12-person cross-functional team under a high-pressure transition phase. Managed to reduce load times of our web application by 90%.

experiences.title: PO / Developer
experiences.description: Product Owner and Developer for various internal applications within BASF Business Services GmbH. Responsible for gathering requirements, defining user stories, and reviewing the code of the developers.
experiences.highlights: Led a dual student to embed Camunda Workflow Engine in a RAD system incl. authorization handling, form routing per task, task management and process management frontend and custom script task engine setup.

experiences.title: Working Student - Web Development
experiences.description: Working Student in Web Development, contributing to various internal projects and gaining practical experience in software development.
experiences.highlights: Delivered early feature increments that accelerated onboarding into enterprise software development practices.

experiences.title: Teamlead
experiences.description: Teamlead in a warehouse build-up project to support the first month of the handover from the former service provider to BLG. Main targets were documenting workflows, taking inventory and onboarding staff. It was a project-based contract, as I started my studies immediately afterwards.
experiences.highlights: Stabilized operations during provider handover by documenting critical workflows and coordinating rapid team ramp-up.

experiences.title: Security Staff
experiences.description: Intermediate job while studying for my Bachelor Professional of Business. I worked as security staff mainly as a doorman, but also securing construction sites at nighttimes.

experiences.title: Truck Planner
experiences.description: Planned routes for trucks from paper recycling facilities to factories.

experiences.title: Warehouse Planner
experiences.description: Planned and managed operations in a distribution center, prepared and organized work for the warehouse staff. Planned and supervised loading activities.
experiences.highlights: Coordinated the loading and unloading of several heavy machinery transports with up to 10t per package.

experiences.title: Apprentice - Warehouse Logistics
experiences.description: Apprenticeship in a production warehouse. Learned everrything from receipt over commissioning to JIT production delivery.

experiences.title: Warehouse Worker
experiences.description: Commissioned goods for JIT delivery in a production warehouse.

experiences.title: Production Worker
experiences.description: Worked in a color pigments factory in 12h shifts. Loaded and unloaded stoves. Packaged pigments.
